Suvarna Projects Limited 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Delhi · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/46/2011/149 
 Dated: March 31, 2026 
 
 CertifiCate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Mini Water Supply - Delhi Pkg-149" (water supply),
 
 awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) ,
 has been completed in all respects on April 10, 2011 at a gross executed value of INR 1.06 Cr
 
 (Rupees 1.06 Crore Only). 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
 
 workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Deepa Chatterjee. This certificate is issued
 for record and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to
 establish past performance. 
 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Suvarna Projects Limited
